cover.standfirst: The technical person you bring in when a project needs a solution nobody has drawn yet.

who.heading: Engineer. Founder.
who.body: Full-stack engineer with depth in AI and AI infrastructure, based in Nairobi. The technical person you bring in when a project needs a solution nobody has drawn yet.
who.invonics: Founder of Invonics Technologies — we audit how a business actually works, then refine its systems or build new ones.

what.heading: Whole systems.
what.body: I design and build whole systems — backend, frontend, mobile, and the AI inside them. Backends that move money and survive load, web apps in React and Angular, Android in Kotlin, and AI systems end to end: training my own models locally, integrating LLMs, and building the fine-tuning and RAG pipelines around them.

solves.heading: Software that has to hold up in real conditions.

items.condition: Thousands of buyers, one ticket tier, no overselling
Payments that confirm even when the M-Pesa callback never arrives
Classrooms with patchy signal that still work offline
Many schools on one system, each one's data walled off
AI that does real work but leaves the final call to a person
Answers grounded in your own material, with faithfulness measured

for.heading: Who it's for.
for.tail: And any team that needs technical depth without a full-time hire.
